audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows are wrong on both layers. Packet is Garen, Garen, Garen, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick; the pages read Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick. Garen's three real windows are given away and Yorick's two strongest stages are softened to 'Skill'. diffRating also reads 8/10 against a 54.59% win rate and a diff token of EVEN.
audit.why: whys[0] 'Garen's early base stats and Q burst beat ghoul-less Yorick at level 1', whys[1] 'At 2 your silence-auto trade still out-damages his weak early kit', whys[2] 'Level 3 Q-E all-in lands before his ghoul package fully online', whys[3] 'By 4 his E-mark, Mist Walkers, and W cage trap and out-damage you', whys[4] 'Maiden at 6 doubles Yorick's ghoul pressure'. The early prose says outright 'You own levels 1-3'.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2, 3 -> Garen (7/10, 6/10, 6/10); Levels 4-5 and Level 6 -> Yorick, ratings already at 4/10 so only the side token moves. First item and 2+ items already read Yorick. diffRating 8/10 -> 5/10 with the difficulty prose restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] gives Dark Procession as 30s and treats the cage as an inescapable box. Both are wrong, and the page never says the wall can be destroyed.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.' It is destructible — Garen breaks a segment with Judgment or autos and walks out, which turns the single scariest tool in this matchup into a delay. Cooldown is 20/18/16/14/12, so 20s at rank 1, not 30s. Separately, Mourning Mist only slows (and shreds armour) — Decisive Strike 'breaks free of all slows affecting him' on cast, so the mist's slow does not stop your gap-close or your exit.
audit.corrected: State the 20s rank-1 cooldown, that the wall is destructible, and that Decisive Strike purges the Mourning Mist slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] describes the Maiden vaguely and gives no cooldown for Eulogy of the Isles.
audit.why: Riot's R text: the Maiden causes Yorick's attacks against her target to deal bonus damage, and she raises Walkers from dead enemies. Cooldown is 160/130/100 — 160s at rank 1, one of the longest in the game. That number is the whole reason 'fight him when the Maiden is dead or unsummoned' is real advice rather than a platitude.
audit.corrected: Give the 160s rank-1 cooldown and describe what the Maiden actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues is 0.
audit.why: Last Rites is 6s at rank 1 and heals him, and it is an auto-attack reset, so his damage and sustain both key off it. Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1. Those two numbers give a concrete open-here window.
audit.corrected: All-In Windows now sequences off the 20s Dark Procession downtime and the moment Last Rites goes on cooldown.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 and flags heal+autoReset

audit.why: Unlike several other matchups on this champion, the Executioner's Calling first back is genuinely right here — Last Rites heals him on a 6s cooldown, which is exactly the needs-antiheal rule missingInteractions flags.

edits.after: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 and the wall is destructible — hit it. Mourning Mist only slows, and Decisive Strike purges slows.

notes: Level-chart edits are one atomic group (content win[0..4] plus full phases[0..4]); phases[3] and phases[4] needed only a side token because their 4/10 rating was already correct for a Yorick-favoured stage. Biggest content gain: the page treated Dark Procession as an inescapable cage on a 30s cooldown. It is 20s at rank 1 and Riot's own text calls the wall destructible — Garen can break a segment and leave, which is the difference between a death and a trade. Also noted that Mourning Mist's slow is purged by Decisive Strike's cast. Did not touch the ghoul/Mist Walker damage claims (whether Judgment cleaves them efficiently, whether they block Garen's pathing) — Riot's passive text says only that they 'swarm and attack nearby enemies' and I could not verify the rest; recorded in unverified.
